% Total electric field (ideal + Ohmic + ambipolar)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C3_E_total}
\mathbf{E} = -\mathbf{v}\times\mathbf{B} + \eta_O\mathbf{J} + \eta_A\,\frac{(\mathbf{J}\times\mathbf{B})\times\mathbf{B}}{|\mathbf{B}|^{2}}

% Ideal Poynting flux
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C3_S_ideal}
\mathbf{S}_{\mathrm{ideal}} = (-\mathbf{v}\times\mathbf{B})\times\mathbf{B} = |\mathbf{B}|^{2}\mathbf{v} - \mathbf{B}(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{B})
\end{equation}

% Non-ideal heating rates
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C3_Q}
Q_{\mathrm{Ohm}} = \eta_O|\mathbf{J}|^{2},\qquad Q_{\mathrm{amb}} = \eta_A\,\frac{|\mathbf{J}|^{2}|\mathbf{B}|^{2} - (\mathbf{J}\cdot\mathbf{B})^{2}}{|\mathbf{B}|^{2}} = \eta_A|\mathbf{J}_{\perp}|^{2}
\end{equation}

% Total-energy conservation with non-ideal MHD
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C3_energy}
\partial_t E + \nabla\!\cdot\!\left[(E+p^{\star})\mathbf{v} - \mathbf{B}(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{B}) + \mathbf{E}_{\mathrm{ni}}\times\mathbf{B}\right] = 0
\end{equation}

% Internal-energy source (non-ideal heating)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C3_internal_energy}
\partial_t(\rho e) + \nabla\!\cdot\!(\rho e\,\mathbf{v}) = -p\,\nabla\!\cdot\!\mathbf{v} + Q_{\mathrm{Ohm}} + Q_{\mathrm{amb}}
\end{equation}
